title: Mailgun Prefix-less 32-8-8 hex key triplet, Mailgun Private API key and HTTP webhook signing key and 1 more: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: the dash between the two 8-character segments removed, so the value is 32-16 rather than 32-8-8. Twin of "Mailgun Prefix-less 32-8-8 hex key triplet, Mailgun Private API key and HTTP webhook signing key and 1 more: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
